reports.claim: Options are cut off on phone screen.
reports.suggestion: App team: option HTML nests (D) inside (C)'s span; sanitise spans before render.
reports.evidence: All four options exist and the key (C, 99 N) is correct; the option markup has deeply nested, unbalanced <span>s that wrap badly on narrow screens - a rendering problem, not content.
reports.student_reply: Thanks for telling us - the question itself is fine (the answer is 99 N); the options were getting cut off by a display problem on phones. We've passed it to the app team so it gets fixed.
